# 24 Color Washable Premium Crayons

- WASHABLE CRAYON. Measure 3 9/16" x 5/16". Made from paraffin wax - Non toxic and safe. Assorted classic colors make your drawings come to life. Come with a box for convenient storage.
- UNLIMITED IMAGINATION. Inspires your little to explore, discover, play, create and dream. Great holiday gift or birthday gift for adult, student, teacher, and artist.
